tasks.analysis: The sea lion population is booming on the Southern California coast, particularly around the San Diego area, where their thriving numbers are giving environmental scientists a reason to celebrate. This year, the number of baby sea lions researchers have counted on the California coastline is nearly double the amount counted just five years ago. This dramatic increase follows a pattern documented in other parts of the world, including on the coasts of Japan and Korea where sea lion populations have also rebounded strongly after dramatic drops in the 1990s. 南加州海岸的海狮数量正大幅增长，尤其是在圣地亚哥地区附近，它们数量的蓬勃增长让环境科学家们有了庆祝的理由。今年，研究人员在加州海岸线上统计到的海狮幼崽数量，几乎是五年前统计数量的两倍。这一显著增长符合世界其他地区已记录的规律，包括日本和韩国的海岸 —— 那里的海狮数量在 20 世纪 90 年代大幅下降后，也出现了强劲的反弹。
